description: Defines classes and interfaces for managing a pool of resource grids in a wireless communication system, including resource grid pool wrapper and implementation classes, with focus on resource management, scope control, and asynchronous zeroing.

classes.name: resource_grid_pool_wrapper
classes.description: Controls the state and scope of a shared resource grid, ensuring proper reservation and release within a pool.

classes.name: resource_grid_pool_impl
classes.description: Implements a pool managing multiple resource grid wrappers, handling allocation, deallocation, and asynchronous zeroing.

methods.name: try_reserve
methods.description: Attempts to reserve the resource grid for use, returning true if successful.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the resource grid, transitioning its reference count to available.

methods.name: notify_release_scope
methods.description: Notifies the pool that a scope has been released, part of the pool interface.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Provides access to the underlying resource grid, part of the pool interface.

methods.name: allocate_resource_grid
methods.description: Allocates a resource grid for a given slot, managing resource requests.
